note: Approved by Gero on 2026-10-16 from run dev-10k-t0 with two edits (see that run's taxonomy_proposal.json); t2 moves recommendations-autoplay from usability to catalog, where the grading contract puts recommendations.

access.name: General access problems
access.definition: Complaints that the user cannot get into the app or account with no clearer cause; not phone-number, password or launch errors.

access.name: Phone number login errors
access.definition: Login rejected with check-your-number or cannot-connect messages when using a phone number; not password or social login.

access.name: Password and social login failures
access.definition: Password, email or Facebook login that is rejected or errors; not phone-number login.

access.name: Logouts and signup blocks
access.definition: Being logged out unexpectedly, losing an account, or being unable to create or finish signing up; not repeated login errors.

access.name: App fails to open or connect
access.definition: App stuck on the splash screen or showing connection or no-internet errors at launch; not playback errors after login.

usability.name: General usability problems
usability.definition: Complaints about how the app works or feels that fit no other usability subtopic.

usability.name: Ad frequency and placement
usability.definition: Too many ads, ads that play after an ad-free window, or ads interrupting listening; not paywall pricing.

usability.name: Shuffle, order and seeking
usability.definition: Forced shuffle, inability to play songs in order, repeat or seek to a part of a track, when not caused by free-tier limits; controls locked to premium go to billing.

usability.name: Interface and layout changes
usability.definition: Redesigned screens, removed icons, or features moved or hidden after an update; not missing features locked by premium.

playback.name: General playback problems
playback.definition: Complaints that audio does not play properly with no clearer pattern, including bad quality.

playback.name: Playback stops or app crashes
playback.definition: Music stops mid-track or after one song, or the app crashes while playing; not slow loading.

playback.name: Buffering and slow loading
playback.definition: Long waits to load lists or start tracks, and buffering or glitching during playback.

playback.name: False offline or no-internet errors
playback.definition: App reports no connection or offline status even though the internet works; not launch failures.

playback.name: Bluetooth, car and watch control
playback.definition: Problems controlling or connecting playback through Bluetooth, car systems or smartwatches.

downloads.name: General download problems
downloads.definition: Download complaints that fit no other downloads subtopic.

downloads.name: Downloads fail to start or save
downloads.definition: Songs or podcasts cannot be downloaded at all or stall during download; not deleted after saving.

downloads.name: Downloads disappear or re-download
downloads.definition: Saved downloads are deleted, lost after updates, or downloaded again repeatedly.

downloads.name: Offline playback needs network
downloads.definition: Downloaded content will not play offline or still needs a connection to start; not failure to download.

catalog.name: General catalog gaps
catalog.definition: Complaints about the music library or content that fit no other catalog subtopic.

catalog.name: Recommended and suggested content
catalog.definition: Recommended songs, suggested clips or autoplay replacing what the user chose to play; not songs added to the user's own playlists.

catalog.name: Lyrics missing or not loading
catalog.definition: Lyrics not shown, failing to load, or lyric features missing; not lyrics locked behind premium.

catalog.name: Songs or podcasts missing or removed
catalog.definition: Specific songs, artists, shows or episodes are absent, unavailable or removed from the catalog.

catalog.name: Unwanted songs added to playlists
catalog.definition: The app adds songs to the user's own playlists without consent; not recommendations shown separately.

catalog.name: Content bias and policy complaints
catalog.definition: Complaints about artist favoritism, controversial hosts, or removal of content for political or policy reasons.

billing.name: General billing complaints
billing.definition: Complaints about premium or payment that fit no other billing subtopic.

billing.name: Basic features locked behind premium
billing.definition: Features users expected for free, such as lyrics, skipping, choosing songs, queue, seeking or downloading, are locked to premium; not the subscription price itself.

billing.name: Premium price too high
billing.definition: Complaints that the premium subscription costs too much for the value; not feature locks.

billing.name: Charges, purchases and cancellation
billing.definition: Unexpected charges, cancellation not working, or purchase and region errors when buying premium.

support.name: General support complaints
support.definition: Complaints about customer support that fit no other support subtopic.

support.name: Unhelpful or rude support replies
support.definition: Support agents or replies that are unhelpful, scripted, rude or absent.

support.name: Support channels not working
support.definition: Email, forms or support pages that glitch or cannot be found; not the quality of replies.

other.name: Other
other.definition: General criticism with no supported specific topic
